# 金光明經玄義順正記

**ID:** X0359
**Volume:** X20
**Category:** 經集部類
**Original Category:** 大小乘釋經部／方等部疏
**Byline:** 宋 從義撰
**Dynasty:** 宋
**Date:** 960–1279
**Juans:** 3
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/X0359

## Contributors
- 從義 (A001057)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

X359 is [從義](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BE%9E%E7%BE%A9)'s three-fascicle Northern-Sòng subcommentary on Zhìyǐ's *[Xuányì 玄義](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0304)* (T1783), parallel to but distinct from [知禮](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9F%A5%E7%A6%AE)'s *[Shíyí jì 拾遺記](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0305)* (T1784). The title's *shùnzhèng* 順正 ("conforming to the correct") signals the work's polemical posture: it claims to be a *correction* of [知禮](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9F%A5%E7%A6%AE)'s reading at points where [從義](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BE%9E%E7%BE%A9) judged the *Sìmíng* master's account divergent from Zhìyǐ's intent.

**Abstract**

The opening dialogue of the preface explicitly engages the existing exegetical landscape: "or someone asks: from of old, those who have written *jì* on this *xuányì* are many. And the masters of Qiántáng (i.e. the *shānwài* tradition) have all said that the single section of *guānxīn* is something later men brashly added — only Sìmíng Fǎzhì (= [知禮](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9F%A5%E7%A6%AE)) defended it as the master's own teaching, and to this day no one fails to transmit it. Why now do you alter and rewrite it? I fear no one will adopt your version, and it will be cast out by the road." [從義](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BE%9E%E7%BE%A9)'s reply is twofold: (i) he does not abandon the *guānxīn shì* but follows [知禮](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9F%A5%E7%A6%AE) in retaining it; (ii) he nonetheless judges that [知禮](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9F%A5%E7%A6%AE)'s sectional analysis ("分科釋義頗有疎失") and his analysis of the title (specifically the reading of 金光明 as a *single dharma-name* 單法為名) are flawed.

The work is therefore best understood as *intra-shān-jiā* polemic — [從義](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BE%9E%E7%BE%A9) working within [知禮](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9F%A5%E7%A6%AE)'s broad framework but correcting it at the level of philological detail. Date bracket follows [從義](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BE%9E%E7%BE%A9)'s mature productive period at the Tiāntái scholastic establishments (1070–1091; he died Yuányòu 6 = 1091, age 50). Together with *[Wénjù xīnjì 文句新記](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0315)* (X360) on the *wénjù* side, X359 is one of the two principal post-[知禮](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9F%A5%E7%A6%AE) Sòng subcommentaries on the *Suvarṇaprabhāsa*.

Related canonical texts: parent commentary [KR6i0304](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0304) (金光明經玄義 / T1783); paired commentary [KR6i0315](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0315) (金光明經文句新記 / X360); rival/predecessor [KR6i0305](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0305) (金光明經玄義拾遺記 / T1784).
